title: A PUBLIC APOLOGY.
summary: I identified the bell found in the third retrieval cabinet as belonging to Saint Jude’s. The sexton has shown me that Saint Jude’s possesses all six of its bells. I withdraw the identification, but not the sound heard on Sunday.
author: Agony Column Desk
